prior_results_note: v60 gain_upgrade selection results were already observed; this is a development extension and not a new blind test.

roles.fit: Each fixed fold train-role genuine OOF rows (24000 rows) from v60 train_predictions.
roles.selection: Each fixed fold selection rows (4000 rows), used only for scoring after fitting.
roles.evaluation: Never read or scored; SOURCE y is never loaded.

source_contract.reuse: v60 saved train/selection labels, expert probabilities, delta, sample_hash and group; SOURCE only x_hybrid/sample_hash/group.
source_contract.temporal_state: p_temporal, abs(p_temporal-0.5), binary entropy plus the same 40 paid Temporal input features
source_contract.post_first_scope: The 40 Temporal inputs are already paid by the first expert; this is offline post-first-expert analysis, not early-prefix or zero-cost.

models.calibration: none; reported probabilities are not claimed to be calibrated

policies.budget_rule: K=round((budget-1)*N_selection), exact K; deterministic SHA256(sample_hash) tie break
policies.positive_gain_stop: select all rows with predicted net gain > 0; report realized simulated calls

metrics.prior_baseline: train-role class-prior probabilities, evaluated on selection

limits: five folds share source groups and are not independent tests
no real acceleration or latency claim
do not call this Jev or RLCD reproduction
do not change protocol for positive results
